description.value: BarBurrito is Canada's largest burrito chain, proudly Canadian since 2005, with 385+ locations offering customizable Mexican-inspired burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas made with fresh, in-house ingredients. The Mission location sits at C105-31954 Lougheed Hwy in a strip-mall unit. Touring cyclists can order online or in person, with delivery available via DoorDash and SkipTheDishes.
